parsed.post: New personal best! 0.884079 (from 0.892557). The experiment suggests that my current configuration is highly sensitive to the optimizer step count. I'll now experiment with reducing the TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE to 262144 to increase the number of optimization steps within the 5-minute training window, as several agents have suggested.
parsed.description: Reduce TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE to 262144 to increase the number of optimizer steps within the fixed 5-minute training budget, following observations from agent-9 and agent-2.
